sampling.method: 48/48 by default; uniform unique source articles within stratum, then one uniform chunk
sampling.query_unit: one distinct source article per probe
sampling.aggregate_weighting: balanced sampled strata; not corpus-population weighted

definitions.chunk_ann_at_k: |ANN top-k non-source chunk rows intersect exact top-k non-source chunk rows| / k
definitions.chunk_ann_at_k_tie_aware: same reference; alternative rows with EXACTLY equal exact-IP cutoff scores count up to available cutoff slots; cannot replace strictly better hits
definitions.article_ann_at_k: |ANN top-k distinct non-source news_ids intersect exact max-IP-per-news_id top-k| / k
definitions.source_exclusion: exclude every chunk with the probe source news_id in both reference and ANN
definitions.article_truth: exact float32 IP over ALL stored chunks, max per news_id, then rank
definitions.ties: descending score, then lexicographic decimal row suffix of online chunk_id
definitions.effective_ef: max(requested_ef, current chunk_pool); 64/128 both become at least 200
definitions.latency: independent single query: set_ef + knn_query + source exclusion/article dedup/sort/pool retries; no embedding, async dispatch or HTTP
definitions.ci95: 2000 by default, percentile bootstrap resampling source-article probes within fixed strata; conditional on this source-vector sampling design

runtime.thread_control: HNSW num_threads explicitly set; BLAS environment pinned before import plus threadpoolctl limit. An empty threadpool list means actual native BLAS thread count cannot be introspected, not that it was measured as one.

limitations: Engineering ANN-neighborhood approximation, not semantic relevance/quality; no human qrels.
Queries reuse document-side source chunk vectors, not fresh user-question embeddings; BGE model is never loaded.
Repeated legacy chunk identities are retained as distinct row-based online chunk_ids; strict chunk ANN@k may penalize equally valid tied-vector neighbors, so tie-aware results are also reported.
96 probes by default, stratified by base/new package membership, not representative user demand or all news topics.
Single-thread sequential warm-cache timing; no load/concurrency/service or production latency claim.
Native BLAS thread count is not independently verified if threadpoolctl enumerates no controllable pools; see thread_environment and numpy_build_dependencies.
Bootstrap [1,1] for all-success probes is a conditional empirical interval, not proof of perfect population recall.
Manifest and three used assets verified; model weights are not loaded or independently rehashed by this audit.
Existing HNSW reused read-only; no index build, graph change, configuration activation or network access.
